central_node: Yoga–a Way of Life: Holistic Mind-Body Integration
plot_summary_nodes: Yoga originates from Sanskrit 'yuj' (to join), symbolizing unity of mind, body, thought, and action.
Sage Patanjali codified yoga in the 'Yoga Sutras' to quiet the mind and eliminate mental distractions.
True asana practice combines controlled physical postures, conscious breathing (pranayama), and focus.
Regular yoga improves strength, flexibility, and focus, while tools like the WHO mYoga app broaden access.
character_arc_nodes: Sage Patanjali: Ancient philosopher who systematized yoga into a structured discipline for mental clarity.
theme_and_moral_nodes: Primary Theme: Mind-body unity and lifelong holistic health.
Moral Lesson: Disciplined breathing and physical focus create inner peace and focus.
key_grammar_nodes: Nouns vs Verbs (Practice/Practise, Advice/Advise): Practice/Advice (nouns) vs Practise/Advise (verbs).
Expository Connectors: Words structuring technical explanations.
